purpose: Teach: 待望/見慣れ/あいにく/小麦/大まか/風習/嘆き/気まぐれ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、待望の試合、明日だな
lines.en: Hey, Riku — your big match is tomorrow, right?
lines.style: Bright, direct, leaning forward slightly. Quick opening. Genuine curiosity mixed with teasing familiarity. The tone of someone checking in on something that matters to a friend.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、見慣れた制服も、卒業すれば懐かしくなるな、桜
lines.en: You know, Sakura… once we graduate, I think I'll actually miss the uniform we see every day.
lines.style: Soft, genuine, a little distant. Speaking half to her, half to the thought itself. Slower pace. The kind of reflection that catches both of them a little off guard.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、あいにくの雨で部活、休みだぞ
lines.en: Rain messed things up — club practice got cancelled today.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact delivery with a hint of frustration underneath. Brief, almost resigned. The way you mention an inconvenience you've already accepted.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、小麦アレルギーじゃなかったろ?桜
lines.en: Wait — you're not allergic to wheat, are you? I thought you were fine with it.
lines.style: Gentle, uncertain check-in. Slight questioning lift at the end. He's genuinely trying to remember correctly, not challenging her. Careful, warm tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のプラン、大まかに聞かせろよ
lines.en: So what's the plan? Give me the rough outline.
lines.style: Straightforward, direct request. Leaning in slightly. She's comfortable asking him for details — no softening, just clear expectation that he'll tell her.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、お祖父ちゃんちで地方の風習体験したろ?桜
lines.en: Didn't you end up experiencing some of the local customs when you stayed at your grandpa's place?
lines.style: Gentle curiosity, a little tentative. Slower, reflective pace. He's reaching back into memory, trying to draw a connection. Warm but not pushy.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のテストの嘆き、わかるぜ
lines.en: I get it, you know — I hear you about the test. That whole thing sounds rough.
lines.style: Sympathetic, matter-of-fact. Leaning in like she's on his side. Warm but not overdone — just the solid presence of someone who understands without needing details.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、気まぐれに勉強するなよ、桜
lines.en: Don't just study whenever you feel like it, okay? You need to actually stick with it.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Direct eye contact level. There's care underneath — he's not lecturing, he's pushing her to do better because he knows she can. A little insistent on the opening.
